d: On Friday all flights were cancelled for a big chunk of the day, Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy and Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin put their brains together to solve the issue, Trump did a real disappearing act on this one by not posting about it until Sunday morning, he spent a lot of time blaming Biden, everyone other than Trump seems to believe that the woman who former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with is a Chinese spy, Stephen A. Smith sat down with Trump for a one-on-one interview, and an all-new edition of This Week in Florida.
